calendar: Can schedule meetings and events, including setting times and participants.
Can list upcoming appointments and events based on specified time periods.
excel: Can format workbook sheets, including applying styles to rows, columns, and headers.
Can compute values using formulas, such as summing columns and calculating differences.
shell: Can transfer files between directories and manage file locations efficiently.
Can adjust file permissions to ensure correct access or execution settings.
word: Can identify and correct spelling and grammatical issues in existing Word documents.
Can apply text formatting and structure adjustments to improve the readability of Word documents.
email: Can compose and send email messages to communicate meeting details and notifications.
Can search for specific emails based on keywords, subjects, or sender information.
llm: Can rephrase text to simplify language or adjust tone for clarity and engagement.
Can summarize content concisely, extract key takeaways, or classify sentiment effectively.
ocr: Can extract textual content from scanned PDF documents for editing purposes.
Can recognize and convert text from images or screenshots into editable formats.
pdf: Can extract and read text content from multi-page PDF documents.
Can convert PDF files into editable Word documents or image formats.
database: Can execute complex SQL queries to retrieve filtered and aggregated data.
Can insert, update, or delete records in relational database tables.
translator: Can translate documents and text passages between multiple languages.
Can detect the source language of a text before applying translation.
file_archiver: Can compress files and directories into ZIP or TAR archive formats.
Can extract the contents of an existing archive to a target directory.
barcode_scanner: Can decode product barcodes and QR codes from image files.
Can generate new QR code images encoding text or URL payloads.
currency_converter: Can convert monetary amounts between currencies using current exchange rates.
Can retrieve historical exchange rates for a specific past date.
contact_manager: Can look up contact details by name from an address book.
Can add new contact entries with phone, email, and address fields.
time_tracker: Can start and stop work timers linked to projects or task labels.
Can log manual time entries with duration, project, and start time.
invoice_processor: Can extract line items, amounts, and vendor details from invoice documents.
Can validate that invoice subtotals correctly sum to the grand total.
code_reviewer: Can run static analysis on source code and report style violations.
Can produce a human-readable summary of code changes from a diff.
travel_booker: Can search available flights between airports for a given travel date.
Can book hotel rooms with specified check-in and check-out dates.
audio_transcriber: Can convert speech recordings into time-stamped text transcripts.
Can identify and label different speakers within an audio recording.
form_filler: Can populate named fields in digital forms with provided data values.
Can submit completed forms and capture the resulting confirmation response.
log_analyzer: Can filter application logs by severity to extract error-level entries.
Can compute event frequencies and occurrence counts from log files.
contract_manager: Can populate legal contract templates with party names, dates, and terms.
Can flag contract clauses that deviate from standard boilerplate language.
inventory_tracker: Can update stock quantities and track inventory item movements.
Can generate reorder alerts for items below minimum stock thresholds.
chart_builder: Can create bar charts and line graphs from tabular data series.
Can render data visualizations as image files in multiple formats.
ticket_manager: Can create support tickets with descriptions, priorities, and assignees.
Can update the status or reassign existing tickets in a tracking system.
package_manager: Can install software packages at specified versions into an environment.
Can list all currently installed packages and their version numbers.
password_manager: Can securely store and retrieve service credentials by service name.
Can rotate secrets and audit credential access history for services.
dns_resolver: Can query A, MX, TXT, and CNAME records for a given domain.
Can perform reverse DNS lookups to resolve IP addresses to hostnames.
meeting_summarizer: Can distill meeting transcripts into structured summaries with key decisions.
Can extract action items with assigned owners and deadlines from transcripts.
video_editor: Can trim video clips to specified start and end timestamps.
Can concatenate multiple video clips into a single merged output file.
social_media_poster: Can draft social media posts with captions, hashtags, and attached media.
Can schedule prepared posts for publication at a specific future time.
weather_service: Can retrieve current weather conditions for a given city or coordinates.
Can return multi-day weather forecasts for a specified geographic location.
recipe_finder: Can find recipes based on available ingredients or dietary restrictions.
Can return step-by-step cooking instructions for a named recipe.
fitness_tracker: Can log workout sessions with exercise type, duration, and calories burned.
Can generate weekly activity reports summarizing workouts and body metrics.
spell_checker: Can scan text for spelling and grammar errors and list corrections.
Can automatically correct all detected spelling errors in a text passage.
image_resizer: Can scale images to specified width and height dimensions.
Can convert image files between formats such as PNG, JPEG, and WebP.
bookmark_manager: Can save URLs with titles and tags into an organized bookmark collection.
Can search saved bookmarks by keyword or tag and return matches.
notification_sender: Can dispatch push notifications with title and body to specific recipients.
Can send bulk notifications to a list of users or device groups.
data_anonymizer: Can detect and redact personally identifiable information from text passages.
Can mask PII columns in CSV datasets and return sanitized versions.
xml_parser: Can evaluate XPath expressions against XML documents and return matching nodes.
Can validate XML documents against XSD schemas for conformance checking.
survey_builder: Can build questionnaires with multiple question types and distribute survey links.
Can export aggregated survey responses as downloadable spreadsheet files.
expense_reporter: Can log business expenses with amount, category, date, and receipt reference.
Can generate formatted expense reports grouped by category with totals.
api_tester: Can send HTTP requests with configurable method, headers, and request body.
Can validate API responses against expected status codes and JSON schemas.
backup_manager: Can create snapshot backups of specified directories or file sets.
Can restore files from a previously created backup to their original location.
color_picker: Can generate harmonious color palettes derived from a given base color.
Can convert color values between HEX, RGB, and HSL representations.
geolocation_service: Can geocode street addresses into latitude and longitude coordinates.
Can compute the distance in kilometres between two geographic coordinate points.
signature_verifier: Can verify the digital signature of signed PDF documents for authenticity.
Can validate certificate chains associated with cryptographic document signatures.
task_scheduler: Can create scheduled jobs with cron expressions and commands to execute.
Can list all configured scheduled tasks with their next run times.
unit_converter: Can convert numeric values between metric, imperial, and other unit systems.
Can handle conversions across length, weight, volume, temperature, and speed.
sentiment_analyzer: Can classify text passages as positive, negative, or neutral in sentiment.
Can detect fine-grained emotions like joy, anger, or surprise in text.
